## How the score was worked out

Each result implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average, with a small pull toward the middle for thinly tested models. Each test's weight is its *counts* column above; here it is added up by who ran the tests. ## How to run it

### llama.cpp (recommended)

1. Install llama.cpp. Homebrew and winget installs name the commands llama-cli and llama-server instead. [Other ways to install](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/master/docs/install.md)
   
   ```sh
   # macOS / Linux
   curl -LsSf https://llama.app/install.sh | sh
   # Windows
   irm https://llama.app/install.ps1 | iex
   ```

2. Run Kimi K2 Instruct (0905) (ud-q4_k_xl, needs ~588.12 GB, from [huggingface.co/unsloth](https://huggingface.co/unsloth/Kimi-K2-Instruct-0905-GGUF/tree/ca516d05c7621c0615db3fc7efa63c9617547363))
   
   ```sh
   llama cli -hf unsloth/Kimi-K2-Instruct-0905-GGUF:UD-Q4_K_XL
   ```

3. Or start a local server and open the address it prints (http://localhost:9931)
   
   ```sh
   llama serve -hf unsloth/Kimi-K2-Instruct-0905-GGUF:UD-Q4_K_XL
   ```

Other versions: ud-q2_k_xl (~383.57 GB) `llama cli -hf unsloth/Kimi-K2-Instruct-0905-GGUF:UD-Q2_K_XL` · ud-iq1_s (~281.9 GB) `llama cli -hf unsloth/Kimi-K2-Instruct-0905-GGUF:UD-IQ1_S`

### LM Studio

1. Install LM Studio. Open the app once before using the lms command. [Download it (macOS / Windows / Linux)](https://lmstudio.ai/download)

2. Run Kimi K2 Instruct (0905) (ud-q4_k_xl, needs ~588.12 GB, from [huggingface.co/unsloth](https://huggingface.co/unsloth/Kimi-K2-Instruct-0905-GGUF/tree/ca516d05c7621c0615db3fc7efa63c9617547363))
   
   ```sh
   lms get https://huggingface.co/unsloth/Kimi-K2-Instruct-0905-GGUF@UD-Q4_K_XL -y
   ```

3. Then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name

Other versions: ud-q2_k_xl (~383.57 GB) `lms get https://huggingface.co/unsloth/Kimi-K2-Instruct-0905-GGUF@UD-Q2_K_XL -y` · ud-iq1_s (~281.9 GB) `lms get https://huggingface.co/unsloth/Kimi-K2-Instruct-0905-GGUF@UD-IQ1_S -y` · 3bit (~449.3 GB, Mac only) `lms get https://huggingface.co/mlx-community/Kimi-K2-Instruct-0905-mlx-3bit -y`

### MLX (Mac)

1. Install MLX (Mac). Apple silicon Macs only, text only.
   
   ```sh
   # with uv
   uv tool install mlx-lm
   # or
   pip install mlx-lm
   ```

2. Run Kimi K2 Instruct (0905) (3bit, needs ~449.3 GB, Mac only, from [huggingface.co/mlx-community](https://huggingface.co/mlx-community/Kimi-K2-Instruct-0905-mlx-3bit/tree/426c860cd40026e83dbaa6d9f12db5b082f6b1af))
   
   ```sh
   mlx_lm.chat --model mlx-community/Kimi-K2-Instruct-0905-mlx-3bit
   ```

3. Or start an OpenAI-compatible server at http://localhost:8080/v1
   
   ```sh
   mlx_lm.server --model mlx-community/Kimi-K2-Instruct-0905-mlx-3bit
   ```
